summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Ambev S.A., a Brazilian foreign private issuer, reporting monthly securities and derivatives transactions in June 2026 as required by CVM Instruction #44/2021. It details the opening balance of 247,967,585 common shares in treasury, a series of open-market purchases (totaling 66 million shares at prices around R$16–16.66) via Santander, and delivery of restricted shares. No fundamental change in control, recommendation, or strategic event is announced. No special situation.
